title: Trump reiterates pledge to send $5,000 checks, and hands out smaller payments, as midterm elections loom
summary_full: Trump renewed a $5,000 check pledge tied to Republican control of Congress as $500 ACA refunds go out and $90 Medicare rebates are scheduled.
summary_public: Trump renewed a $5,000 check pledge tied to Republican control of Congress as $500 ACA refunds go out and $90 Medicare rebates are scheduled.
